2026-10-27.patch_summary: This patch removes the legacy ->iomap_begin()/->iomap_end() path in the iomap code, as all in-tree filesystems have implemented the ->iomap_next() method. The changes involve updating the iomap_iter function to use the ->iomap_next() method instead of the legacy path and removing the corresponding flags and functions from the iomap_ops structure. This change simplifies the iomap code and reduces its complexity.
